cases.title: Truncated zigzag int
cases.paragraph: A continuation bit of 1 requires another byte.

cases.title: String shorter than declared length
cases.paragraph: A string is a long length plus that many UTF-8 bytes.

cases.title: Union branch index out of range
cases.paragraph: The branch index must refer to an existing union arm.

cases.title: Enum index out of range
cases.paragraph: An enum is a zigzag int that must be a valid symbol index.

cases.title: Fixed value shorter than size
cases.paragraph: A fixed value is exactly size bytes.

cases.title: Array block truncated
cases.paragraph: An array is a sequence of blocks ended by a zero count.

cases.title: Avro int 0
cases.paragraph: int is a variable-length zigzag varint. 0 encodes as a single 0x00.

cases.title: Avro int 1
cases.paragraph: Zigzag maps 1 to 2, encoded as 0x02.

cases.title: Avro int -1
cases.paragraph: Zigzag maps -1 to 1, encoded as 0x01.

cases.title: Avro boolean true
cases.paragraph: boolean is a single byte, 0 or 1.

cases.title: Avro string kelp
cases.paragraph: string is a long byte-count followed by UTF-8. Count 4 zigzag-encodes as 0x08.

cases.title: Avro empty bytes
cases.paragraph: bytes is a long count plus that many raw bytes. Count 0 is 0x00.

cases.title: Avro null has no payload
cases.paragraph: null is written as zero bytes.

cases.title: String count longer than remaining bytes
cases.paragraph: The declared byte count must be present.

cases.title: Truncated zigzag varint
cases.paragraph: A continuation bit requires another byte.

cases.title: Union [null, string] with a string
cases.paragraph: A union writes the branch index as a long, then the value. Branch 1 is 0x02.

cases.title: Union [null, string] with null
cases.paragraph: Branch 0 (null) is a single 0x00.
